capacity.why: questions about a lot or a title, asked of the register, answered one at a time by its clerks

keeps.why: The land registry makes the register of land: the plan of each lot is part of it.
The register of land it keeps: every title is made by being entered in it.
The register of land it keeps: every dealing in a title.
The register of land it keeps: every title given up.
The register of land it keeps: what has been struck from it.
